projectDescription: A production-ready Node.js trading bot for Polymarket that supports both a dual-sided BTC Up/Down arbitrage strategy and a configurable copy-trading engine for mirroring target wallet activity on Polygon.
keyFeatures: Dual-sided ladder execution on recurring BTC 5-minute Up/Down markets
Taker arbitrage logic triggered when combined best ask drops below configured edge threshold
On-chain merge and redeem support for Polymarket negative-risk markets
Session and per-market risk controls including spend caps and circuit breakers
Automatic CLOB credential derivation via Polymarket's L1-to-L2 auth flow
Live WebSocket order-book tracking with REST fallback
Dedicated buy-only copy-trading engine with staleness, price, and spend filters
Structured Winston logging to console and file
publicApiSurface: npm start — launch main arbitrage bot (TRADING_MODE=arb)
npm run copy — launch dedicated copy trader (TRADING_MODE=copy)
npm run arb — explicit arbitrage mode via cross-env
npm run dev — arbitrage bot with Node file watcher
ActivityFeed class (src/copy/activityFeed.js) — target wallet trade poller
mergePositions() (src/onchain.js) — burn matched YES+NO pairs for USDC
redeemPositions() (src/onchain.js) — claim winning token payout after resolution
